lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: i pointed at three things on the board and didn't have to ask about any of them. sushi day, curry edition :)

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: so cheap the trip fund didn't even notice we celebrated. best kind of party

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: fresh, bright, and my legs feel ready for tomorrow. my cousin doesn't stand a chance

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: oh... every pot on this board has meat in it. i asked twice, just in case

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: this is the exact opposite of sushi day. nope. everyone up, mina is not eating plain rice at my celebration

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: we're moving! mina, you lead us to the next stall. you were supposed to pick first

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: the curry was SO good. then i found out the sauce is mostly cream and butter. latte night, the sequel. my stomach is filing a complaint

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: oh roxy, i'm sorry. come sit with me, we'll get you some water and take the slow way out

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: loved the flavour, but i can feel every drop of that oil. at this rate my cousin's going to be pacing me

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: i'll hand you water at the start line tomorrow. promise

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: great curry. two dollar signs, though. i'm walking home and putting the bus fare back in the fund

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: i'll walk with you! celebration parade, coast edition

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: firefly lane! still love it here. but the poll said curry, and i'm the one who counted the votes

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: it's just as lovely as last time :) curry can be next market night, brooke
